image_description: A close-up photograph of a white, intricately branched fungus growing on decaying wood. The fungus exhibits a coral-like structure with numerous cylindrical branches arising from a common base and dividing into finer, pointed tips. The color is predominantly creamy white to pale yellow. The background consists of dark brown wood and some green moss.
